---
title: "Free Website Brief"
toc: false
---

::: {.website-brief-hero}
<span class="eyebrow-line">Free tool · public pages only</span>

# See your website through a fresh pair of eyes.

<p class="hero-subtitle">Drop in a public website address. The Website Research Assistant turns the visible page into a concise brief, then stays with you for a few follow-up questions.</p>

<div class="brief-boundary"><span>Reads one public page</span><span>•</span><span>No login areas</span><span>•</span><span>Session clears after 24 hours</span></div>
:::

::: {.website-brief-shell}
<form id="website-brief-form" class="website-brief-form" novalidate>
<label for="website-url">Website address</label>
<div class="website-brief-input-row">
<input id="website-url" name="url" type="url" inputmode="url" autocomplete="url" placeholder="https://yourwebsite.com" required>
<button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Create my brief <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
</div>
<p class="form-hint">Try a homepage or service page you own or are permitted to review.</p>
<p id="website-brief-status" class="brief-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</form>

<section id="website-brief-result" class="website-brief-result" hidden aria-live="polite">
  <div class="brief-source"><span>Reading</span><a id="brief-source-link" href="#" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"></a></div>
  <div class="brief-summary-card"><span class="section-label">The brief</span><p id="brief-summary"></p></div>
  <div class="brief-grid">
    <article><h2>What the offer seems to be</h2><ul id="brief-offer"></ul></article>
    <article><h2>Who it appears to serve</h2><ul id="brief-audience"></ul></article>
    <article><h2>Clarity notes</h2><ul id="brief-clarity"></ul></article>
  </div>
  <article class="brief-opportunity"><span class="section-label">A practical opportunity</span><h2 id="brief-opportunity-title"></h2><p id="brief-opportunity-detail"></p></article>
  <article class="brief-questions"><h2>Questions worth asking next</h2><ul id="brief-questions-list"></ul></article>
</section>

<section id="website-brief-chat" class="website-brief-chat" hidden>
  <div class="brief-chat-heading"><span class="section-label">Continue the research</span><h2>Ask about this website</h2><p>Answers are grounded in the page you provided.</p></div>
  <div id="brief-messages" class="brief-messages" aria-live="polite"></div>
  <form id="website-brief-chat-form" class="brief-chat-form">
    <label class="visually-hidden" for="brief-question">Your question</label>
    <input id="brief-question" maxlength="900" placeholder="What would make the offer clearer?" required>
    <button class="btn btn-outline-primary" type="submit">Ask</button>
  </form>
</section>

<div class="brief-next-step">
  <div><span class="section-label">Want to act on it?</span><h2>Turn the best opportunity into a working system.</h2><p>Bring the brief to a short Google Meet call and we can decide what deserves to be built.</p></div>
  <a href="https://calendar.app.google/d7Ttfbm1Masri4vB8" class="btn btn-primary">Book a Google Meet call</a>
</div>
:::

<script>
(() => {
  // This is deliberately a different service from the SisengAI support chatbot.
  const API = window.__SISENG_RESEARCH_API__ || "https://research.sisengai.com";
  const form = document.querySelector("#website-brief-form");
  const urlInput = document.querySelector("#website-url");
  const status = document.querySelector("#website-brief-status");
  const result = document.querySelector("#website-brief-result");
  const chat = document.querySelector("#website-brief-chat");
  const messages = document.querySelector("#brief-messages");
  let sessionId = null;

  const setList = (selector, items) => {
    const target = document.querySelector(selector);
    target.replaceChildren(...(items || []).map((item) => {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      li.textContent = item;
      return li;
    }));
  };
  const setStatus = (message, kind) => {
    status.textContent = message;
    status.className = "brief-status " + (kind || "");
  };
  const readError = async (response) => {
    try {
      const body = await response.json();
      return body.detail || "The assistant could not complete that request.";
    } catch (_) {
      return "The assistant could not complete that request.";
    }
  };
  const addMessage = (role, text) => {
    const item = document.createElement("div");
    item.className = "brief-message " + role;
    item.textContent = text;
    messages.append(item);
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;
  };
  const showBrief = (data) => {
    const brief = data.brief || {};
    const source = document.querySelector("#brief-source-link");
    source.href = data.source_url;
    source.textContent = data.title || data.source_url;
    document.querySelector("#brief-summary").textContent = brief.summary || "";
    setList("#brief-offer", brief.offer);
    setList("#brief-audience", brief.audience);
    setList("#brief-clarity", brief.clarity);
    setList("#brief-questions-list", brief.questions);
    document.querySelector("#brief-opportunity-title").textContent = (brief.opportunity || {}).title || "A practical next step";
    document.querySelector("#brief-opportunity-detail").textContent = (brief.opportunity || {}).detail || "";
    sessionId = data.session_id;
    result.hidden = false;
    chat.hidden = false;
  };

  form.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const url = urlInput.value.trim();
    if (!url) return;
    const button = form.querySelector("button");
    button.disabled = true;
    setStatus("Reading the public page and making your brief…");
    try {
      const response = await fetch(API + "/analyse", {method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({url: url})});
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(await readError(response));
      showBrief(await response.json());
      setStatus("Your brief is ready.", "success");
      history.replaceState(null, "", "#brief");
    } catch (error) {
      setStatus(error.message || "The assistant could not complete that request.", "error");
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  document.querySelector("#website-brief-chat-form").addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const input = document.querySelector("#brief-question");
    const message = input.value.trim();
    if (!message || !sessionId) return;
    const button = event.currentTarget.querySelector("button");
    addMessage("visitor", message);
    input.value = "";
    button.disabled = true;
    addMessage("assistant pending", "Researching the page…");
    try {
      const response = await fetch(API + "/chat", {method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({session_id: sessionId, message: message})});
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(await readError(response));
      messages.querySelector(".pending")?.remove();
      addMessage("assistant", (await response.json()).answer);
    } catch (error) {
      messages.querySelector(".pending")?.remove();
      addMessage("assistant error", error.message || "Try that question again shortly.");
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
      input.focus();
    }
  });

  const suppliedUrl = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("url");
  if (suppliedUrl) {
    urlInput.value = suppliedUrl;
    form.requestSubmit();
  }
})();
</script>
